turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm okay, I guess. Still a bit sleepy, but my knee doesn't hurt too much.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Can you rate your pain for me, out of 10?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe a 3 or 4. There's some soreness, but it's manageable.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or feeling like you might be sick?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I feel fine. No dizziness or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. How's your breathing? Any discomfort or tightness in your chest?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I'm breathing fine. A bit more aware of my breathing, but it's okay.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: You mentioned you have mild asthma. Any wheezing or shortness of breath at all?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing like that. I didn't even need my inhaler today.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. And just to check, do you remember the surgery being done?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yeah, I remember waking up and being moved here. It's a bit fuzzy, but I know what happened.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks for confirming. We'll keep an eye on your pain and breathing, especially with your asthma and weight, but you're looking good so far.
